propositions: A provider-neutral logical-operation contract must define outcome enumerations (Disposition, FailureScope, ReplaySafety, DelaySource) and ensure one canonical logical_id persists across all physical invocations of a single operation.
Retry budget must limit execution to at most three physical invocations and 15,000 ms cumulative sleep using fake-clock scheduling, with authoritative provider delays as lower bounds.

Diagnostic entries must admit only six keys (stage, category, status_code, provider_code, retry_after_ms, message), redact all via the centralized seam, and truncate to 512 Unicode code points per message, with overflow sentinel for eight-plus entries.
Equivalent outcomes must serialize to byte-identical compact UTF-8 JSON via canonical_bytes with sorted keys and no inline serializer.

After ambiguous writes, observe desired primary-store postcondition before replay; observed desired state produces recovered, while failed or inconclusive observation produces non-replaying commit_unknown with ReplaySafety.forbidden.

Zero-based retry_index selects exponential jitter delays [2s,3s) for index 0 and [4s,5s) for index 1, with no third sleep permitted and provider delays that exceed remaining budget returning retry_not_before without incrementing counters.
